description:
OPTIONAL, after the checks pass: ways to make the checkout, Stripe Checkout, emails and cancellation flow convert or retain better WITHOUT breaking automatic-renewal laws; every after-example passed Checkbox's checks for the merchant's states.
Each gives apply.where + apply.content (exact copy, Stripe JSON patch or flow change), preconditions (never apply one whose precondition is false) and guardrails with requirement ids. Never invent figures or add urgency, pre-checked boxes or obstacles.
With a site id: from what Checkbox observed. Or send your copy: terms + any of disclosure, page_html, stripe_checkout_session_params, emails, cancellation_flow (as in the check_* tools).
Failing surfaces are held (fix them first). Never blocking, never counted toward compliance. After applying one, re-run the check in verification.operation_id.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

cancellation_flow.description: Your cancellation flow, one entry per screen from the account page to the confirmation.

disclosure.description: Your own checkout (as in check_disclosure, plan terms in terms).

text.description: Disclosure next to the purchase button, as rendered.

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

other_plans.description: Other plans you sell (enables cheaper-plan / plan-choice suggestions).

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

page_html.description: Rendered checkout page HTML (as in check_page_html).

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

stripe_checkout_session_params.description: Exactly what your code passes to stripe.checkout.sessions.create.

terms.description: The plan sold (price or amount, interval, trial_days, merchant_name, cancel_url). Required with disclosure or emails.

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

trial_reminders.description: You send a trial-ending reminder to every trial subscriber.

title: Suggest conversion improvements that keep the checks passing
